title: A hidden entity picking recruits from the GATE pool

tellings.quote: different entity that is utilizing Gate behind the scenes to find a pre-selected pool of people and pull them into the programs

plain: Behind GATE, a US school programme for gifted children, some other hidden group is quietly picking out chosen children and pulling them into secret programmes, according to Jordan Jose, who tells Michels he was taken into the UFO programme himself as a child. He describes a "different entity that is utilizing Gate behind the scenes to find a pre-selected pool of people." If true, it would mean the secret programmes recruit their people from childhood.
